content: निष्पद् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To issue out of, spring from. .²2 To be produced, be brought about, arise, to be effected; निष्पद्यन्ते च सस्यानि <ls>Ms. 9. 247</ls>. .²3 To be got ready or prepared. .²4 To become ripe, ripen. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To produce, bring about, cause, effect, prepare; द्रव्यक्षित्यात्मलिङ्गानि निष्पाद्य प्रोक्ष चासनम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 3. 50</ls>; त्वं नित्यमेकमेव पटं निष्पादयसि <ls>Pt. 5</ls>.
